svg.title: Step 1: Hiring signals (now versus target)
svg.desc: Step 1 Hiring signals. Now: Search cards with a recruiter-style suffix; Bulk export of LinkedIn posts; A post is a lead only if its text holds an e-mail; Poster check counts display names, skips reposts; No content analysis. Target: Person-first query families; URL capture through lib.fetch_post; Signal classifier: hiring-intent weight; Keep leads without an e-mail. Metric: Share of kept leads whose author is a hiring owner or in-house recruiter rises against the day-30 baseline; signal classifier precision ≥ 85%.
